panels.description: Five-minute average daylight observations. Irradiance is plotted on the x-axis and outdoor temperature on the y-axis.

targets.rawSql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT floor(extract(epoch FROM observed_at) / 300) AS bucket, AVG(solar_w_m2) AS irradiance, AVG(outdoor_temp_f) AS temperature FROM weather_observation WHERE $__timeFilter(observed_at) AND solar_w_m2 > 10 AND outdoor_temp_f IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT irradiance AS "Irradiance", temperature AS "Temperature" FROM buckets ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Temperature vs Irradiance

panels.description: One point per station-local calendar day over the last year. Dry days are included. X is the most negative rolling 3-hour relative-pressure change observed that day; Y is total daily rainfall.

targets.rawSql: WITH pressure_change AS (SELECT current.observed_at, current.relative_pressure_inhg - previous.relative_pressure_inhg AS change_inhg FROM weather_observation current JOIN LATERAL (SELECT relative_pressure_inhg FROM weather_observation previous WHERE previous.observed_at <= current.observed_at - INTERVAL '3 hours' AND previous.relative_pressure_inhg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY previous.observed_at DESC LIMIT 1) previous ON TRUE WHERE current.observed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 year' AND current.relative_pressure_inhg IS NOT NULL), daily_pressure AS (SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS observation_date, MIN(change_inhg) AS largest_drop_inhg FROM pressure_change GROUP BY 1) SELECT daily_pressure.largest_drop_inhg AS "Largest pressure drop", daily_weather_summary.rainfall_in AS "Rainfall" FROM daily_pressure JOIN daily_weather_summary USING (observation_date) WHERE daily_weather_summary.observation_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' ORDER BY daily_weather_summary.observation_date

panels.title: Daily Rainfall vs Largest 3-Hour Pressure Drop
